descs: An anime-style illustration depicts two characters in a dynamic pose. In the foreground, a male character with blond hair and green eyes stands with his back to the viewer, wearing a blue, red, and white military-style uniform with gold trim. He holds a silver sword with a green hilt in his right hand. Floating above him is a female character with blond hair, also in a blue and white uniform with a beret, holding two silver guns with her arms outstretched. Red ribbons or energy trails connect the two characters in a circular pattern. The background features a large, faded statue of a woman in a classical pose, set against a warm, golden architectural backdrop with columns and decorative patterns. Large, translucent blue crystal formations are visible at the bottom of the image.

A male character and a female character in uniforms pose dynamically, with the male character holding a sword and guns held by the female character connected by ribbons, set against a statue and crystals.
A vibrant red ribbon loops elegantly around the scene, framing a central figure and connecting to a sword hilt. The ribbon's smooth texture contrasts with the metallic sheen of the weapon.
A female character with long, flowing hair stands in a dynamic pose, her body angled slightly to the side. She wears a sleeveless top and a skirt, with a red ribbon or sash flowing behind her.
A character wields two silver swords, one in each hand, extending outward from the body. The blades are straight and gleam with a metallic sheen, contrasting against the blue and gold armor.
A long, slender sword with a silver blade and a green hilt featuring white diamond-shaped patterns. The sword is held upright by a mechanical hand.
A vibrant red ribbon with a gold trim, featuring a white emblem with a blue cross. The ribbon is tied in a knot, showcasing its glossy texture and precise stitching along the edges.

A vibrant red ribbon is elegantly draped across a light-colored surface, creating a striking contrast. The ribbon's smooth texture and flowing shape are highlighted by soft lighting, emphasizing its delicate nature.
A green sword blade with a pattern of white diamond shapes along its length. The blade is partially visible, showing a sharp edge and a metallic tip.
A long, slender, white blade with a smooth surface and a slightly curved tip. The blade is set against a background of blue and yellow geometric shapes.
